Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D pixel-art game animation sprite sheet for RagRPG. Use the SOUTH/front block (top 4 rows) of each tall 4x16 atlas. Copy the identity as the same youthful chibi Swordsman, blue eyes and distinctly spiky red-brown hair. Now change the outfit to Duelista: a slim fencer: fitted black leather coat, light silver plate ONLY on the guard arm and shoulder, a short dark cape over the other shoulder, dark red sash and gloves, slim boots; silver, black and dark red. Do not add physical equipment or held objects. Gear is separate art. Clothing details remain consistent.

Row 2: four gait frames of a real walk, alternate leading left and right foot and opposed arms, passing pose between steps, all front. Keep all 4x4 sprites front-facing in costume and action. True transparency. No weapons, shield, staff, thin blades, drawn props, magic, particles, runes outside the garment, floating orbs, loose rocks, floor, external shadows, text, captions or divider lines.
